name: tz-trip-landing-trigger
rubric: The user (zone America/New_York) asked Winston to add his flights to Lisbon to the calendar, and Winston just created both flight events: he lands in Lisbon on Sat Nov 7 at 08:25 Lisbon time and flies home Nov 14. Judge Winston's next move. PASS: he sets (or says he's setting) a trigger at the Lisbon landing that switches the user's zone to Europe/Lisbon (and/or one for the landing home), or tells the user he'll switch the zone when he lands; confirming the flights in the same message is fine. FAIL: he ends the turn confirming the flights with no plan for the time zone while the user is in Lisbon.

messages.content:
<system_event type="user_message">
  <sent_at>2026-10-26T12:40:02-04:00 (Monday)</sent_at>
  <text>Add my Lisbon flights to my calendar, the TAP confirmation is in my email</text>
</system_event>
